meta.title: Polk County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Polk County's 2026 budget as filed with the state: the quorum court's budget ordinance and the county's 2026 budget summary report. We use the 'Original Budget' column. The County General Fund budgets $197,774.96 in 'Transfers'; if that money goes to other county funds, those dollars appear in both funds.
